title: Curador
description: This project allows people to see @SuperRare artists and their artworks using different visualizations and capabilities that exists today on SuperRare web site. It's possible to see how the history of CryptoArt on @SuperRare evolved and discover valuable insights to add pieces to your collection.
how_its_made: This project uses a dataset of JSON files extracted from SuperRare website using their v2 GraphQL API. The dataset was uploaded to a AWS S3 bucket where it was transformed into a list of all nfts not burned orderer by tokenId. There is a front end uses Bulma.io and Vuejs.org and the back end developed in Golang.
